fichas.title: Sound Insulation
fichas.summary: Explains sound propagation, hearing and sound-intensity measures, sound reduction and insulation, airborne and impact sound, boundary frequency, and lightweight sound-insulating construction. Heavy, thick elements generally provide sound insulation by mass; flexible cladding with cavity filling can improve insulation by reducing internal sound reflection.
uses: Assessing sound insulation and sound reduction in buildings
Understanding airborne, structure-borne, and impact sound
Comparing sound levels and boundary frequencies of building elements
